import heapq
import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    A = list(map(int, data[1:1+N]))

    def compute_prefix_scores(arr):
        # scores[i] = optimal value for first 2i elements
        scores = [0]
        top_heap = []          # min-heap of top half
        bottom_heap = []       # max-heap (negated) of bottom half
        top_sum = 0
        bottom_sum = 0
        i = 0
        L = len(arr)
        while i + 1 < L:
            x = arr[i]
            y = arr[i+1]
            i += 2
            heapq.heappush(top_heap, x); top_sum += x
            heapq.heappush(top_heap, y); top_sum += y
            s = heapq.heappop(top_heap); top_sum -= s
            heapq.heappush(bottom_heap, -s); bottom_sum += s
            while top_heap and bottom_heap and top_heap[0] < -bottom_heap[0]:
                a = heapq.heappop(top_heap); top_sum -= a
                b = -heapq.heappop(bottom_heap); bottom_sum -= b
                heapq.heappush(top_heap, b); top_sum += b
                heapq.heappush(bottom_heap, -a); bottom_sum += a
            scores.append(top_sum - bottom_sum)
        return scores

    if N % 2 == 0:
        sorted_A = sorted(A)
        m = N // 2
        print(sum(sorted_A[m:]) - sum(sorted_A[:m]))
    else:
        prefix = compute_prefix_scores(A)
        suffix = compute_prefix_scores(A[::-1])
        ans = 0
        for k in range(1, N + 1, 2):
            left_len = k - 1
            right_len = N - k
            score = prefix[left_len // 2] + suffix[right_len // 2]
            if score > ans:
                ans = score
        print(ans)
